statement: Account Executives struggle to complete effective discovery within standard 30-minute call windows, running out of time before understanding deep buyer pain or setting next steps.
normalized_problem: Insufficient call time to complete thorough discovery and establish next steps
desired_outcome: Uncover critical business pain and align on clear next steps within a tight 30-minute timeframe without feeling rushed.
current_solutions: Rigid time-allocation frameworks (e.g., 2 mins intro, 18 mins discovery, 6 mins next steps)
Standardized discovery templates and cheat sheets
attempts: Allocating fixed minutes for rapport and agenda setting before asking discovery questions
solution_complaints: Light rapport and agenda setting consume half the call window, leaving minimal time to dive deep into buyer pain points.
path: Account Executives struggle to complete effective discovery within standard 30-minute call windows, running out of time before understanding deep buyer pain or setting next steps.
